description: Read back a checkout created with swop_create_checkout: its status (active, pending_payment, paid, settled, expired, cancelled), the payment request if one is published, and the line items. Poll this after the buyer has been shown the payment to learn when it lands — paid means the buyer's money arrived; settled means the seller has been paid out. Only the linked account's own checkouts are visible.
name: swop_get_checkout
title: Check a checkout
